subject: Noob Question - Error on deployApp() from RStudio to shinyApps.io

messages.author: 847d6c850d50fb2e
messages.subject: Noob Question - Error on deployApp() from RStudio to shinyApps.io
parts:
I'm doing the Coursera  "Developing Data Products"  course and am just trying to get the demo running on shinyapps.io

It runs correctly on my local machine, but when I try to deploy I get

> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 100342...DONE
Deploying bundle: 443514 for application: 100342 ...
Waiting for task: 181345769
  building: Parsing manifest
  error: Building package: xtable
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 181345770 error: Unhandled Exception: HTTP 599: Connection closed
> 

Any idea what the problem is and how to fix ?

Thanks !

messages.author: e2ca5093917af03b
messages.subject: Re: Noob Question - Error on deployApp() from RStudio to shinyApps.io
parts: Make sure you don't have temp files in your folder / i.e. opened excel file in the folder can generate hidden files... so close it before deploying so the excel releases the hidden temp files ;)

messages.subject: Re: Noob Question - Error on deployApp() from RStudio to shinyApps.io
parts:
Pat, 
Any chance you are running with R 3.3.0?  If you are running with R 3.3.0 you will regrettably get a 599 error today, we will hopefully add support for 3.3.0 shortly. In the interim. If you are running with 3.3.0, downgrading to 3.2.5 will solve the problem.  Sorry about the bad error message.

-Tareef
